# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 67 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 48 | Coptic

---

## Saying 67

Jesus said: "He who knows all but is deficient within himself is entirely deficient."

---

**Translator's Notes (LOGOS):**

- "Deficient within himself" — "within himself" locates the deficiency properly as interior
- "Entirely deficient" — the emphatic totality of the second clause
- "He who knows all" — gnomic third person, universal claim
